Application Data.NAME: Shutterbug Studios
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Shutterbug Studios specializes in portrait, event, and commercial photography, providing high-quality services in a dedicated studio space. Our offerings include professional photo shoots for individuals and businesses, along with ancillary services such as makeup and hairstyling for clients. We pride ourselves on using standard studio equipment, ensuring a safe and creative environment for all projects. We do not use drones or engage in any chemical processing, adhering strictly to best practices in photography. Our studio maintains an inventory valued well below $500,000 and has implemented robust security measures to protect our equipment and clientele.
